name: byte-entropy
title: Byte Entropy
description: Shannon entropy of bytes, over a whole buffer or fixed-size windows, for spotting packed or encrypted sections. Bit-for-bit the same as scipy.stats.entropy.
input_unit: bytes of random data; entropy of every 4 KiB window (step 4 KiB). Reference: numpy.bincount over all windows at once + scipy.stats.entropy(axis=1)

usage.python:
from kura_rs import byte_entropy

# Same float as scipy.stats.entropy(numpy.bincount(data, minlength=256), base=2)
h = byte_entropy.entropy(data)

# (offset, entropy) of every whole 4 KiB window (step defaults to the window size)
for offset, h in byte_entropy.windows(data, 4096):
    if h > 7.2:
        print(f"{offset:#x}: likely packed ({h:.2f} bits/byte)")

# Overlapping windows: 4 KiB every 1 KiB (the GIL is released while computing)
byte_entropy.windows(data, 4096, 1024)
